title: Dynamic behavior of the p53-Mdm2 core module under the action of drug Nutlin and dual delays.
authors: Yang, Juenu; Yan, Fang; Liu, Haihong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Nutlin药物作用下p53-Mdm2网络的时间延迟与Hopf分岔振荡动力学，属于信号通路数学模型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Nutlin is a family of p53-targeting drugs. It is able to bind to Mdm2, thereby accelerate the accumulation of p53 that is a prominent tumor suppressor. An integrated module of the Nutlin PBK and p53 pathway is composed of positive feedback mediated by Mdm2 mRNA as well as the drug Nutlin and negative feedback mediated by Mdm2 protein. The main research content of our paper is how the time delay of protein synthesis, response time delay of Nutlin drug, the degradation rate of Mdm2, the degradation rate of p53 depended on Mdm2 and the actual dose of Nutlin in the cell affect the oscillatory behavior caused by Hopf bifurcation in the integrated network system of Nutlin PBK and p53 pathways. The stability of the unique positive equilibrium point and the existence of Hopf bifurcation are studied by taking the time delays as the bifurcation parameters and applying bifurcation theory. Based on the normal form theory and central manifold theorem, explicit criteria to determine the Hopf bifurcation direction and stability of the bifurcated periodic solution are established. It is found that the time delays and key parameters in the integrated network system of Nutlin PBK and p53 pathways play an important role in the amplitude and period of p53 oscillation according to the results from the numerical simulation and theoretical calculation. These results may provide us with a better understanding of the biological functions of the p53 pathway and some clues for cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: Nutlin是一类靶向p53的药物家族。它能够与Mdm2结合，从而加速作为显著肿瘤抑制因子的p53的积累。Nutlin PBK与p53通路整合模块由Mdm2 mRNA及药物Nutlin介导的正反馈和Mdm2蛋白介导的负反馈组成。本文主要研究内容为蛋白质合成的时间延迟、Nutlin药物的响应时间延迟、Mdm2的降解速率、依赖于Mdm2的p53降解速率以及细胞中Nutlin的实际剂量如何影响Nutlin PBK与p53通路整合网络系统中由Hopf分岔引起的振荡行为。以时间延迟为分岔参数，应用分岔理论，研究了唯一正平衡点的稳定性及Hopf分岔的存在性。基于规范型理论和中心流形定理，建立了确定Hopf分岔方向及分岔周期解稳定性的显式判据。数值模拟和理论计算结果表明，Nutlin PBK与p53通路整合网络系统中的时间延迟和关键参数在p53振荡的振幅和周期中发挥重要作用。这些结果可能为我们更好地理解p53通路的生物学功能及提供癌症治疗的线索。
